steps.what: Monitor patient position, vital signs and blood volume and color during the operation
outputs: observed intra-operative status and communicated concerns

tasks.design: Retain direct observation and interpretation of the operative field and the {OTHER} patient monitoring equipment. Existing readings support the assistant without replacing observation or communication of concerns.
tasks.previous_blocker: Patient monitoring combines instrument readings with physical context.
tasks.enabler_now: The digest supplies no verified replacement for this intra-operative work.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising changes that are not captured adequately by a single reading.
tasks.human_edge: Integrate observations and communicate promptly with the clinical team.
tasks.altitude: Monitoring time and clinical responsibility stay unchanged.

reach.task: Maintain shared awareness of operative conditions

evidence.claim: The digest's clinical note drafting and coding capabilities do not demonstrate replacement of intra-operative monitoring.

assumptions: Boundary is this assistant's observation and communication, excluding anesthetic management and separate clinical records.
Monitoring devices produce readings and the assistant observes position and the operative field during s1. No structured stable-patient or normal-blood-loss flag is assumed.
OTHER means patient monitoring equipment. Test existing device functions before additions; no new clinical automation is proposed.
Zero upkeep because no new system or process is introduced.
unknowns: Local scope of practice, devices and team responsibilities
research_questions: Which clinically relevant observations depend on direct operative-field awareness?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross and net zero. Stable and changing intra-operative conditions both retain direct monitoring.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Discuss the procedure and patient requirements with the surgeon

steps.what: Discuss surgical procedure, consent, exposure, laboratory data, directives and patient needs with the surgeon
outputs: shared understanding of procedure and patient requirements

tasks.design: Retain the discussion with the surgeon, referring directly to the {OTHER} clinical record system as needed. No automated briefing is substituted for confirming the patient's requirements together.
tasks.previous_blocker: The conversation resolves clinical ambiguity and establishes shared understanding.
tasks.enabler_now: General documentation drafting does not establish a substitute for this discussion.
tasks.still_hard: Reconciling unclear information and changed patient or procedure requirements.
tasks.human_edge: Ask clarifying questions and confirm what the team understands.
tasks.altitude: Clinical discussion and responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.task: Clarify procedure requirements with the team

evidence.claim: Autoscriber drafts consultation notes; that capability does not demonstrate replacement of a surgical planning conversation.

assumptions: Boundary is assistant-surgeon discussion, excluding consent acquisition, diagnostic testing and separate operative record preparation.

Responsible clinicians and laboratories produce the existing patient record and results. The assistant reads and clarifies them during s1, with all time retained; no consent-valid or procedure-ready structured flag is assumed.
OTHER means clinical record system. Test existing record access before additions; no new process is proposed.
Zero upkeep because no new system or recording mechanism is introduced.
unknowns: Local scope, record availability and briefing procedure
research_questions: Which ambiguities must be resolved directly with the surgeon before proceeding?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gives zero gross and net. Routine and changed procedures retain direct confirmation.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Coordinate patient temperature management with anesthesia personnel

steps.what: Coordinate with anesthesia personnel to maintain patient temperature

tasks.design: Retain live coordination with anesthesia personnel using readings from the {OTHER} patient monitoring equipment. No automated coordination or temperature intervention is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Coordination depends on current patient conditions and team responsibilities.
tasks.enabler_now: The digest supplies no verified replacement for this clinical interaction.
tasks.still_hard: Keeping the team aligned when conditions or priorities change.
tasks.human_edge: Communicate clearly and confirm the intended support action.

reach.task: Maintain shared awareness of temperature management

evidence.claim: Registry and documentation capabilities do not demonstrate replacement of live temperature management coordination.

assumptions: Boundary is this assistant's coordination and support, excluding anesthesia personnel's separate monitoring and treatment work.
Devices and clinicians produce temperature observations; the assistant and anesthesia personnel interpret and communicate during s1. No structured needs-warming or safe-temperature flag is assumed.
OTHER means patient monitoring equipment. Test existing device and communication functions before additions; no new intervention is proposed.
Zero upkeep because no new system or workflow is introduced.
unknowns: Team responsibilities and existing temperature management procedure
research_questions: Where does explicit acknowledgment improve shared understanding of temperature support?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gives zero gross and net. Normal and changing temperature conditions retain live clinical coordination.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Intra-operative monitoring and clinical coordination remain human without a claimed labour reduction.
reach: Clarify shared responsibilities with surgical and anesthesia colleagues
role.ambitious_version: A surgical assistant who communicates observations and clarifies team responsibilities reliably.
